purpose: Projection routing matrix R1-R13, route targets, engine guards, anti-overstep bindings B1-B6, and the 8 machine REJECT codes.

route_targets.description: Project as ARN typed_relation / node / hyper_relation.
Generate MCF handoff record; do not write MCF fabric directly.
Project as PSD element with mandatory system boundary.
Reject routing with a machine-readable reason code.
Insufficient info; suspend as UNKNOWN, never guess.

rules.condition_summary: relation_type in causal_cue_types OR linked assertion proposition hits cue_causal_lexicon OR causal_handoff_ref non-null.
intervention lexicon hit OR intervention action_type OR explicit do-calculus notation.
stochastic cue type/lexicon hit OR numeric probability claim; requires PSD boundary five-part.
risk cue type/lexicon hit; numeric probability required else ARN unknown + residue.
>=1 endpoint ref is a Relation; routes to ARN hyper_relations (members>=3) or native (2-endpoint).
temporal cue/lexicon hit OR temporal_scope.interval non-null; time-impossible path rejected.
support cue hit and not R1/R2; conditions required (B2).
conflict cue hit and not R1/R2; object is proposition/evidence not mechanism.
dependency cue hit; map to dependency/enabling/inhibition (not causal).
similarity cue hit or embedding distance; never upgrades to causality (B3).
adjacency/co-occurrence cue hit; never upgrades to causality/truth/value (B1).
fallback; map by sign or unknown; unfamiliar predicate forces relation_class=unknown (residue).

engine_guards.description: PSD five-part system boundary + probability_value ten-field + obs!=do; missing -> psd_boundary_incomplete.
time-impossible path rejects (T1-T7): reversed interval, MALFORMED, mixed timescale, unknown direction, sequence inversion, topology break, causal escape.
higher-order relation must not silently collapse; preserve_as_higher_order, residue_if_projected, no fabricated third member.

anti_overstep_bindings.value_template: support relation does not establish evidence independence; independence requires separate provenance-disjoint evidence assertion

anti_overstep_bindings.rule: MCF causal_delegated_to_mcf only on router return
anti_overstep_bindings.value_template: causal_delegated_to_mcf writable only by router on ADMITTED handoff return
generic relation (relation_type=generic / R13 unknown) must never set causal_status=established

reject_codes.reason: relation record fails its schema validation.
R3/R4 hit but PSD five-part boundary incomplete.
bare numeric probability outside PSD ten-field discipline.
observational and interventional distributions not distinct.
temporal relation forms a time-impossible path (T1-T7).
PSD record asserts real-world causality without MCF handoff.
